See who Welatino Traveltech LLP has hired for this role
We are looking for enthusiastic Spanish-language writers who are interested in starting their careers in content writing. Candidates must have a DELE B2 certification in Spanish and a strong interest in writing, research, and digital content creation.
No prior professional content writing experience is required. Training and guidance will be provided.
Write Spanish content for travel websites, blogs, and landing pages.
Create content related to flights, airlines, bookings, cancellations, and travel services.
Research travel-related topics and develop informative content.
Assist in creating SEO-friendly content using relevant keywords.
Proofread and edit content to maintain grammatical accuracy and quality.
Develop content for Spanish-speaking audiences, especially in Mexico and Latin America.
DELE B2 certification in Spanish is mandatory.
Good Spanish writing, reading, and communication skills.
Interest in content writing, travel, and digital marketing.
Basic understanding of SEO is an advantage.
Willingness to learn and work on Spanish-language content.
Please submit your application through LinkedIn’s “Easy Apply” option.
